text:
maria: quick pulse — cut window in ~2h. heads up: canary rolling, one cherry-pick stuck (cp/8421). What I did: merged runtime perf tweak to canary, kicked off smoke. Blockers: cp/8421 test failing. Today: triage cherry + decide go/no-go. @kevin can you take the failing test?

kevin: on it. repro'ing locally now. looks like the kv-cache unit test flakes on dtype conversion after quant change. will try a narrow fix + test update. cc PR #8472 when ready.

sanjay: infra report: staging infra green, canary nodes spun (4 nodes). no capacity issues. I'll hold train rollout until we confirm cherry.

linda: pushed branch cp-fix-8421 with a small guard + unit test adjustment, force-pushed. CI queued.

kevin: running unit suite: `pytest tests/test_kv_cache.py::test_prefix_cache -q` — one flake reproduced, applying patch now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for commit abc123def. 1/4 nodes healthy -> 2/4. Logs: https://deploys/redwood/canary/abc123

oliver: quick perf note: seeing +25-40ms p99 on two routes in staging after the perf tweak. could be micro-batching interactions. I can run a microbenchmark and open a perf snapshot.

maria: plan: kevin lands hotfix if green, linda monitors canary latency, oliver gathers perf snapshot. if unresolved by +90m we revert canary and hold train. sanjay will gate full rollout.

kevin: hotfix PR opened: #8472, includes test update and dtype guard. CI green locally, remote checks queued.

linda: CI passed on cp-fix-8421, merging to cherry branch and triggering canary redeploy.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy updated for commit def456ghi. 3/4 nodes healthy -> 4/4. Health checks: all green.

oliver: rerun microbenchmarks — tail p99 back within baseline after micro-batching tweak revert. leaving a note in perf dashboard.

maria: ok excellent. if canary stays healthy we'll open the train in 30m. keep pings short here with status updates only. :thumbsup:

kevin: will post final CI status in 15m.

linda: canary stable at +0m, no errors in logs.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy success: 4/4 nodes healthy. Rolling to train queue in 00:30:00 unless aborted.

maria: thanks all — tagging release owner for lift: @maria. closing loop after rollout. :party_parrot:
